subject: prd/argus-ledger-lint
statement: If If an in-scope `delivery:` citation (per FR-9 — a reference into an existing ledger) names an anchor that resolves to neither a journal `E-n` nor a derived-state field (a dangling or malformed anchor within a real ledger), then the system shall report it as a defect distinct from the DINV-6 derived-block finding — a citation the arm recognizes but cannot resolve is a false-green hole in the arm's own predicate, not a silent pass
intent: a named defect distinguishing "unresolvable anchor" from "cited derived block"
fit_criterion: on a dangling-`delivery:`-anchor fixture (a citation into an existing ledger naming no such entry), the cross-document arm reports a defect that is not conflated with the DINV-6 finding
